Name: 8-10 Foot Patio Umbrella Cover
Natural: Whenever there's a threat of bad weather, you can rely on our Covermates Classic patio umbrella covers to keep your outdoor umbrella safe and sound. Our weatherproof 12mm vinyl umbrella covers are designed to protect against rain, snow, wind, UV sunlight, dirt and more. At Coverstore, we carry five sizes of patio umbrella covers, so chances are that we have the perfect cover for you! In order to properly measure your umbrella, crank it to the closed position so that the umbrella material closes completely around the umbrella pole. With the umbrella closed, measure the circumference around the widest part of the umbrella material. You can also measure the diameter across the umbrella material at the widest point. Next, measure the height (sometimes referred to as length) from the top of the umbrella to where the material ends. Compare your dimensions to the sizes of our five patio umbrella covers shown below and select the size that is equal to or slightly larger than your umbrella dimensions from the drop down menu above. Features of our Classic covers include a locking zipper, mesh vents that allow the cover to breathe, a strong elastic bottom to keep the cover in place and a great 2-year warranty.
